adaptedFor.dshBuild: DSH desktop nightly (profile 'desktop'), captured from the live inspector surface of the running Host and Client
adaptedFor.referenceSource: github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness; the previous record was taken at commit b150a551b8 / published line 0.2.0-rc.2
adaptedFor.captureMethod: cordis_inspect_query over the live runtime: host Service/Event/Config/Tool, client Service/Slots/Builtin/Theme
adaptedFor.lastUpgradeDiff: 0.2.0-rc.2 -> 0.2.1-rc.2. Changes found: skills.register now requires a string `source` (the runtime skill stayed in the catalog but failed to load with 'source must be a string'); SessionPersistenceSnapshot gained formatStatus?: 'current' | 'migration-required'; the shipped session menu gained a session-id row at order 450; the slot's standard props gained useRemoteAccess / useSessionAccess / useWorkspaceAccess. Unchanged: the session log layout is still session.v4.jsonl.zstd, api-session/removed still exists, webServer.register and the workspace storage domain are unchanged, and sessionPersistence still has no delete API.

howToRefresh.principle: This file is a RECORD, not a contract. The contract is the live inspector surface; re-read it before trusting anything below.
steps: cordis_inspect_list (host + client) to see which Inspect Providers this build registers
host Service.listService with no 'service' for the directory; then with service=<key> for the exact contract + referenced types
host Event.listEvents; then with event=<name> for the structured listener contract
host Config.listConfigs with name='dsh-plugin-delete-conversation' to confirm the loader entry is live, and with entry='include:delete-conversation' for its projected Config presence
client Slots.listSubTree (no root) for the tree, then with root='sidebar.workspaces.session.menu.item' for the slot contract and its occupants
client Service.listService and client Builtin.listBuiltins before touching the client bundle
client Theme.listTokens before touching theme tokens
diff the result against seams[] below, patch only what moved, bump pluginVersion/adaptedFor, and re-run the doctor route

seams.expected: runtime skill contribution. SkillRegistration = Omit<SkillDefinition, 'invocation' | 'provider'> and SkillDefinition extends SkillSummary, so `source: SkillSource` is REQUIRED ('runtime' is the canonical bucket for a same-process contribution) and DSH validates it when the skill is loaded; same-name duplicates log a warning instead of throwing, and project/user entries outrank runtime ones

seams.failureMode: optional — a failure is logged and the file-based skill still applies. A missing `source` is not a registration failure: the skill stays in the catalog but every load fails with `loaded skill "<name>" source must be a string` (the 0.2.1-rc.2 breakage this record fixes)
